run_fix_o365_path_default: run the script to filter missing images from the default Objects365 train annotation JSON
run_fix_o365_path_custom_ann: run the script with a custom --ann path to filter a different Objects365 annotation file
run_fix_o365_path_custom_img_dir: run the script with a custom --img_dir to check image paths in a different directory
review_fix_o365_path_logic: review the script logic that iterates annotation images and removes entries for missing files
summarize_fix_o365_path_output: summarize the output JSON file produced after filtering out missing image entries from the annotation
